title: QUIC RFC 9308 Applicability Hardening Work Item
summary: Harden the application-facing RFC 9308 guidance surface with canonical informational requirements, API comments, application-developer documentation, focused requirement-home tests, flow-control and stream-limit diagnostics, and qlog mappings.
planned_changes:
- Add `SPEC-QUIC-RFC9308.json`, `ARC-QUIC-RFC9308-0001.json`, `WI-QUIC-RFC9308-0001.json`, and `VER-QUIC-RFC9308-0001.json`.
- Add application-facing XML comments for 0-RTT replay-safety boundaries, keep-alive versus resumption, stream mapping, stream priority, stream-capacity backpressure, DATAGRAM scope, and application close codes.
- Add `docs/design/rfc9308-application-guidance.md` for protocol authors building on this QUIC stack.
- Add `FlowControlBlocked` and `StreamLimitBlocked` diagnostics and qlog mappings for application backpressure troubleshooting.
- Add RFC 9308 requirement-home tests for public 0-RTT absence, stream priority boundary, flow-control blocked state preservation, stream-limit blocked state preservation, qlog diagnostic mapping, application close-code propagation, and NAT rebinding candidate non-promotion.
verification_plan: Run focused RFC9308 requirement-home tests, run diagnostic/qlog tests affected by the new mappings, run core SpecTrace JSON validation, run generated QUIC requirement coverage triage, and run diff hygiene.
out_of_scope: Automatic fallback to TCP/TLS or another application transport.
Alt-Svc, SVCB, or HTTPS endpoint discovery.
HTTP Datagrams, CONNECT-UDP, MASQUE, or QUIC-LB behavior.
completion_notes: Completed as an informational hardening slice: no new speculative RFC 9308 protocol features were added, and unsupported applicability topics remain explicitly deferred or application-owned.
